ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Adani Power Q2 FY27 Earnings**  Adani Power delivered a "blockbuster" Q2 FY27, reporting a 142% surge in Profit After Tax to over INR7,000 crores, primarily driven by strong power demand, improved plant load factors, and a material one-time prior period revenue adjustment of INR2,422 crores. The company's operational strength is underscored by a credit rating upgrade to AA+ and significant progress on its 24 GW thermal and new hydro capacity expansions, despite a 41.8% increase in fuel costs largely managed by pass-through mechanisms. While the substantial one-time revenue inflated reported PAT, the underlying operational and strategic growth remains strong.
